title: SuperCompress: Free open-source LLM prompt compression - cut token costs ~65%
body:
## SuperCompress: Open-Source Prompt Compression

[SuperCompress](https://github.com/arjunkshah/supercompress) is an MIT-licensed prompt compression library that reduces LLM token costs by ~65% before inference. ~5K parameter CPU policy, 100% oracle recall. pip install supercompress.

Live demo: https://supercompress.dev  |  GitHub: https://github.com/arjunkshah/supercompress
